row.body: The ticket count is closed before the last car’s entry time. A key tag for the projection booth is left with the vehicle list.
row.title: The drive-in count

sidecar.gloss: A car is entered after the event count is closed.
sidecar.rival_reading: A routine late entry could be missed by the count; the list does not establish whether anyone was directed to leave.

row.body: four notches on the folded tarp match four marks on the bath towel; a fifth mark was sanded flat on both.
row.title: missing count beside the folded tarp

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
